answer: Proof of Useful Work provides a robust kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies by requiring computationally expensive operations. Unlike an ivory tower theoretical model, this mechanism forces attackers to expend real electrical energy to generate valid identities. As the tide of malicious agents rises, the cumulative cost of repeated hardware investment and energy consumption makes large-scale identity replication economically non-viable, effectively anchoring network security to physical resource scarcity.
